description: Ministry of  Labour, Trade Union Relations and Sabaragamuwa Development -  Wages Board for the Flowers, Ornamental Plants Vegetables and Fruits Growing and Export Trade, in to Force on the 01.08.2017
categorisation: This gazette notification publishes a determination of minimum wages for workers in the Flowers, Ornamental Plants, Vegetables and Fruits Growing and Export Trade, made under the authority of the Wages Boards Ordinance. It contains regulatory content establishing legal wage requirements, which falls under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) for regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements. While it mentions the Minister of Labour, it does so only in the context of the regulatory authority behind the wage determination, not as a personnel announcement or portfolio description.
